verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents a robust API (plus Terraform provider and PyAirbyte) for programmatically creating connections, triggering syncs, and orchestrating pipelines (airbyte-docs-3, -17, -18, -46), suggesting broad API coverage of core operations. However, several UI-centric capabilities like the no-code Connector Builder and its AI Assistant are explicitly described as 'part of the Airbyte UI' (airbyte-docs-4, -5, -20, -43, -44) with no evidence of equivalent API-driven access, and a probe found no discoverable OpenAPI spec at expected endpoints (airbyte-probe-2), undercutting full API/UI parity claims. missing for 10: evidence that Connector Builder/AI Assist and other UI-only workflows are fully API-accessible, and a working OpenAPI/spec discovery confirming complete API surface parity.
